## 10. Launch Forte Technology Partner (Seth, Nov 9 2026)
**Plan.** One plan, **$500 a month**, month to month, cancel anytime, no annual lock-in, no tiers. It replaces the prior monthly support plan. Positioning: your business technology, handled. Seth is the accountable, familiar technology partner for the client's business software, AI, operations, architecture, engineering and technology decisions.
**10.1 Included, subject to an agreed covered environment and access.**
1. Unlimited everyday engineering requests, handled one active request at a time: software changes, automations, integrations, reports, dashboards, troubleshooting and incremental improvement.
2. Everyday remote business IT and software help: Google Workspace and Microsoft 365 settings, email and calendar problems, app accounts, shared files.
3. Practical security administration: MFA, password and access practices, permissions and unused-account checks.
4. Backup and resilience oversight: critical data and backup inventory, status checks of configured backup jobs.
5. Monitoring and guarded repairs for specifically agreed and instrumented websites, domains, SaaS applications, automations, workflows and integrations, inside permission and safety gates.
6. Architecture, AI adoption, review of AI-built artifacts, cross-system planning and execution of approved everyday scope, including when the client builds some pieces themselves.
7. SaaS and vendor management: software access, subscriptions, license reviews.
8. Proactive intelligence: review of the client's context, operations and known systems for technology risks, savings, manual-work reduction and next worthwhile improvements.
9. A monthly client-specific technology review: monitored health, incidents, changes made and verified.
10. Direct access to Seth for technology questions and triage, through the current service queue and communication policies.
**10.2 Not included (separately quoted or client paid).**
**10.4 Member discount.** A qualifying larger project quoted to a client who has completed three months of paid membership receives a 30% member discount on that project quote.
